Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:10:1.hebrew: יציאותיו - מה שהוציא על הבית. אלמא, מדיהיב ליה כל יציאותיו ואינו מנכה לו שכר מה שעמד בבית, אלמא זה נהנה — שהיה לו לשכור אחרת — וזה לא חסר — דבלאו הכי לא בעי איהו למבנייה — פטור הנהנה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:10:1.english: His expenses - What he spent on the house. Thus, since he gives him all his expenses and does not deduct for him the rent for [the time] that he stayed in the house, thus [this is a case of] "this one derives benefit" — for he would have had to rent another [house] — "and that one does not suffer a loss" — for either way he did not want to rebuild it — the one who derives benefit is exempt.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:10:2.hebrew: דבית לעלייה משתעבד - שעל הבית לסבול העלייה, הלכך הדין עם זה לדור בו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:10:2.english: Because the house is subjugated to the upper story - For it is upon the [lower] house to support the upper story; therefore, this one [the owner of the upper story] has the right to dwell in it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:11:1.hebrew: רבי יהודה אומר כו' - אתנא קמא פליג, דבעל העלייה צריך להעלות שכר לבעל הבית:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:11:1.english: Rabbi Yehuda says, etc. - He disagrees with the first Tanna, [holding] that the owner of the upper story must pay rent to the owner of the house.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:11:2.hebrew: שחרוריתא דאשייתא - שמשחיר לו הכתלים, הלכך חסר הוא, אבל בית ישן לא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:11:2.english: The blackening of the walls - For he blackens the walls for him; therefore, he suffers a loss, whereas [in the case of] an old house, [he does] not.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:12:1.hebrew: שלחוה בי רבי אמי - להא בעיא דלעיל, זה נהנה וזה לא חסר, מהו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:12:1.english: They sent it to the academy of Rabbi Ami - [They sent] that inquiry [mentioned] above: [if] this one benefits and this one does not suffer a loss, what is [the law]?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:12:2.english: What loss did he cause him - This one dwelt in a house that is not up for rent.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:12:3.english: Let us consider the matter - Let us examine it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:14:1.hebrew: לאו בפירוש אתמר - לאו בהדיא שמעה רבי אבהו מיניה דר' יוחנן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:14:1.english: [It] was not stated explicitly - Rabbi Abbahu did not hear it explicitly from Rabbi Yochanan.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:14:2.english: He took a stone or a beam - [The Gemara] explains in Tractate Me'ilah that we are dealing with a [Temple] treasurer.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:14:3.hebrew: לא מעל - דמעיקרא נמי ברשותיה הוי כי השתא, ולא שינוי הוא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:14:3.english: He has not committed misuse - For originally too, it was in his possession just like now, and it is not a change [of possession].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:15:1.hebrew: נתנה לחבירו - קנייה חבירו, דגזבר יש לו רשות ליתן, וזה שהוציאו לחולין מעל:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:15:1.english: He gave it to another - The other [person] acquires it, for a [Temple] treasurer has authority to give [it away], and this one, who removed it to non-sacred [status], has committed misuse [of consecrated property].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:15:2.hebrew: בנאה - גזבר בתוך ביתו, לא מעל כו':
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:15:2.english: He built it - [i.e., if] a treasurer [built it] into his house, he has not committed misuse, etc.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:16:1.hebrew: והוא שהניחה ע"פ ארובה - ולא קבעה בבנין, דלא הוי שינוי. הלכך, לא מעל עד שידור תחתיה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:16:1.english: And [this applies] provided that he placed it over the skylight - and did not affix it into the building, so that there is no change [in it]; therefore, he has not committed misuse [of consecrated property] until he dwells beneath it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:17:1.hebrew: זאת אומרת - מדקתני דכי דר תחתיה חייב, ואע"ג דשלא מדעת הקדש עבד:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:17:1.english: That is to say - Since it teaches that when one dwells beneath it, he is liable, even though he acted without the knowledge of the Temple treasury.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:19:1.hebrew: בהקדש ליכא למימר שלא מדעת, דדעת שכינה איכא. הלכך, כהדיוט מדעת דמי:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:19:1.english: Regarding consecrated property, one cannot say [that it is] without knowledge, for the knowledge of the Divine Presence is present. Therefore, it is like [the property of] an ordinary person [used] with knowledge.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:1:1.english: You have derived benefit - For if [it were] not [for] my courtyard, you would have rented another.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:2:1.english: After you serve me - When you perform one act of service for me, I will tell you.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:2:2.english: Wrapped his scarf for him - He folded his scarf for him.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:2:3.english: [It] pays [for] the benefit that [it] derived - Evidently, we follow [the criterion of] benefit.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:3:1.english: A man whom his Master assisted - [This refers to] Rami bar Ḥama.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:3:2.hebrew: דאע"ג דלא דמיא - ההיא בעיא למתניתין:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:3:2.english: Even though [it] is not similar - that dilemma [is not similar] to the Mishnah.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:3:3.english: He accepted it - Rav Chisda [accepted it] from him, and did not raise any objection against him.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:4:1.hebrew: מפקר להו - ולא חיסר מידי, דהא סופן לאיבוד:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:4:1.english: He renders them ownerless - And [the owner] suffered no loss, since their end is to be lost.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:5:1.english: On three of his sides - That Reuven had three fields next to Shimon's field on three of its sides.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:5:2.hebrew: וגדר - ראובן את הראשונה סמוך לשדה שמעון, לבד מחיצות חיצונות שהיו לו בינו לשאר הבקעות:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:5:2.english: And he fenced in - Reuven [fenced] the first [side] adjacent to Shimon's field, apart from the outer partitions that he had between himself and the rest of the valleys.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:5:3.english: And [he fenced] the second and the third [sides] like this: (*):(*)

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:5:4.hebrew: אין מחייבין אותו - אין מחייבין את שמעון כלום, דמאי אהני ליה? הרי שדהו פתוחה מצד רביעית:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:5:4.english: They do not obligate him - They do not obligate Shimon [to pay] anything, for what did it benefit him? Behold, his field is open on the fourth side.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:5:5.hebrew: הא רביעית - הא אם היה לו לראובן ד' שדות מארבע רוחות של שמעון וגדרן, מחייבין את שמעון לתת את חלקו במחיצות הפנימיות שבינו לראובן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:5:5.english: But [if he fenced in the] fourth - That is, if Reuven had four fields on [all] four sides of Shimon['s field] and fenced them in, [the court] obligates Shimon to pay his share of the inner partitions between him and Reuven.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:6:2.hebrew: וזה לא חסר - ראובן, שהרי יש לו לגדור שדהו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:6:2.english: And that one does not suffer a loss - Reuven, for he has to fence his field.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:6:3.hebrew: הקיפא יתירא - דאי לאו שדה של שמעון בין שדותיו, הוי סגי ליה במחיצות חיצונות והוו כל שדותיו גדורים. והלכך, חסר הוא בשבילו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:6:3.english: A larger circumference - For if Shimon's field were not between his fields, outer partitions would have sufficed for him and all his fields would have been enclosed; therefore, he suffers a loss because of him.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:7:1.hebrew: אם עמד ניקף וגדר את הרביעית - גלי אדעתיה דניחא ליה בהקיפו של ראובן, ומגלגלים עליו את הכל לתת את חלקו בג' מחיצות פנימיות של ראובן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:7:1.english: If [the owner of] the surrounded [field] arose and enclosed the fourth [side] - He has revealed his intent that he is pleased with Reuven's enclosing [of his field], and [the court] imposes upon him [the obligation for] all of it, to give his share in Reuven's three inner walls.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:7:2.hebrew: הא מקיף - הא אם קנה מקיף עוד שדה רביעית אצל שמעון וגדרה, פטור שמעון:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:7:2.english: But [if] the surrounding [owner] - [That is,] if the surrounding [owner] bought another, fourth field adjacent to Shimon and fenced it, Shimon is exempt.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:8:1.hebrew: לדידי סגי לי בנטירא בר זוזא - לא היה יכולת בידי לגדור גדר של אבנים, וסגי לי בגדר קוצים בר זוזא להבדיל ביני ובינך:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:8:1.english: For me, protection worth a zuz is sufficient - I did not have the means to build a stone fence, and a thorn fence worth a zuz is sufficient for me to separate between me and you.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 20b:9:1.english: The house and the upper story - [The] house belongs to this one, and the upper story on top of it belongs to another.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:11:1.hebrew: ת"ש ר"י אומר - ואפילו רבנן לא פליגי אלא משום דביתא לעלייה משתעבד:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:11:1.english: Come and hear: Rabbi Yehuda says - And even the Rabbis only disagree because the [lower] house is subjugated to the upper story:

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:15:1.hebrew: נתנה לחבירו כו' - בפ"ק דחגיגה (דף י:) פריך: מכדי מגזל גזליה, מה לי הוא מה לי חבירו? ומשני: באבני בנין המסורות לגזבר עסקינן. וא"ת: מ"מ למעול, דהוי מתכוין לקנות, ואפילו למ"ד (ב"מ דף מא.) שליחות יד צריכה חסרון, ה"מ כשאין מתכוין לקנות הכל? וי"ל: דאין אדם מועל אלא במתכוין להוציאו מרשות מי שהוא, והכא הוא סבור שלו הוא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:15:1.english: If he gave it to his fellow, etc. - In the first chapter of Chagigah (10b), [the Gemara] asks: "Since he stole it, what difference is there between him and his fellow?" And [the Gemara] answers: "We are dealing with building stones that were entrusted to the treasurer." And if you ask: Nevertheless, let [the treasurer] commit me'ilah [when he takes it], since he intends to acquire [it], and even according to the one who says (Bava Metzia 41a) that misappropriation [by a bailee] requires actual diminution, that applies only when he does not intend to acquire the entire [item]? One can answer: A person does not commit me'ilah unless he intends to remove [the item] from the domain of whoever owns it, whereas here he thinks it is his own.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:16:1.hebrew: והוא שהניחה ע"פ ארובה - פ"ה דלא קבעה בבנין, דלא הוי שינוי, הלכך לא מעל עד שידור תחתיה. ותימה: כי קבעה נמי לא קני, דשינוי החוזר לברייתו הוא, כדאמר בהגוזל קמא (לקמן בבא קמא צו:): האי דגזל נסכא מחבריה עבדיה זוזי, לא קני בשינוי; מ"ט? דהדר עביד להו נסכא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:16:1.english: "And [this is] provided that he placed it over the skylight" - Rashi explained: [This is] because he did not fix it into the building, so there is no [physical] change; therefore, he has not committed misuse [of consecrated property] until he dwells beneath it. And [this is] surprising: even if he fixed it [into the building], he also does not acquire [it], because it is a reversible change, as [the Gemara] states in [the chapter] HaGozel Kama (later, Bava Kamma 96b): One who steals an ingot from his fellow [and] makes it into coins does not acquire [it] through the change; what is the reason? Because one can turn them back into an ingot.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:18:1.hebrew: אשגוחי לא אשגח ביה - ושמואל עצמו הדר ביה, כדאמרינן בפרק השואל (ב"מ דף צט:):
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:18:1.english: He did not pay attention to him - And Shmuel himself retracted, as we say in the chapter [entitled] HaSho'el (Bava Metzia 99b):

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:1:1.hebrew: הא איתהנית - אפילו למ"ד בפ"ק דב"ב (דף יב:) כופין אותו על מדת סדום ויהבינן ליה אחד מצרא, שאני הכא, שהיה יכול למונעו מתחילה מלדור בביתו; ולמ"ד התם מעלינן ליה כנכסי דבר מוריון — משום דדמי למונע חבירו מתחילה לדור בביתו, אבל הכא כבר דר. ואם תאמר: ההוא דתחב לו חבירו בבית הבליעה דריש אלו נערות (כתובות דף ל:), אמאי חייב האוכל? זה נהנה וזה לא חסר הוא, שאם היה מחזיר היתה נמאסת ואין שוה כלום! וי"ל: דלא דמי, הואיל ונהנה מחמת החסרון שהיה מתחילה, מידי דהוי אהא דתנן: "מתוך הרחבה משלם מה שנהנית", דאלעיסה לא מחייב דהוי שן ברה"'ר, אלא אהנאת מעיו מחייב, אע"פ שאם מחזירו אין שוה כלום:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:1:1.english: You have derived benefit - Even according to the one who says in the first chapter of Bava Batra (12b) [that] we compel him against the trait of Sodom and give him [his share] on one border, here it is different, because he could have prevented him from the outset from living in his house. And according to the one who says there [that] we appraise it for him like the properties of Bar Maryon — [that is] because [that case] is comparable to one who prevents his fellow from the outset from living in his house, whereas here he has already lived [there]. And if you ask: [In] that [case] where his fellow stuffed [food] into his throat [at] the beginning of [the chapter] Eilu Na'arot (Ketubot 30b), why is the eater liable? It is [a case of] "this one benefits and that one does not lose," for if he were to return [the food], it would be loathsome and worth nothing! One can answer that it is not comparable, since he benefits from the loss that existed at the outset, just like that which we learned in the Mishnah: "[If the animal ate] from the public square, he pays for what it benefited," for he is not liable for the chewing since it is Shen in the public domain, rather he is liable for the benefit to its stomach, even though if he were to return it, it would be worth nothing.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:4:1.hebrew: אפקורי מפקר להו - לא לגמרי, דא"כ אפילו מה שנהנית לא משלם; אלא מתייאש מהם, שסבור שיתקלקלו מחמת שרבים דורסים עליהם, עד שלא יבואו לדמי מה שנהנית:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:4:1.english: "[He] renders them ownerless" - Not completely, for if so, he would not even pay for what [the animal] benefited; rather, he despairs of them, because he thinks that they will be ruined due to the multitude trampling upon them, to the point that they will not reach the value of what [the animal] benefited:

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:6:1.hebrew: את גרמת לי הקיפא יתירא - מתוך פירוש הקונטרס משמע דמיירי בגדר שבין שדהו לשדה ניקף. וקשה: דהיכי חשיב ליה "זה נהנה וזה אין חסר", הואיל שכל אותו הגדר לא נעשה אלא להפסיק בין שדותיו לשדה ניקף? ועוד, דהוה ליה למימר "את גרמת לי כל זה ההיקף", ד"הקיפא יתירתא" משמע שגרם ליה להרבות. אלא נראה שמבחוץ סביב לד' רוחות הקיף, והקיפא יתירא משום שמחמת שדה האמצעי ההיקף גדול יותר מדאי:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:6:1.english: You caused me an extra circumference - From Rashi's commentary it is implied that [the Gemara] is referring to a fence between his field and the surrounded owner's field. And [this] is difficult: how could [the Gemara] consider it [a case of] "this one derives benefit and that one does not suffer a loss," since that entire fence was only made to separate between his fields and the surrounded owner's field? And furthermore, [the Gemara] should have said, "You caused me this entire circumference," for "extra circumference" implies that he [merely] caused him to increase [it]. Rather, it appears that he enclosed [his fields] from the outside around [all] four sides, and [it is called] an "extra circumference" because, on account of the middle field, the circumference is overly large.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:7:1.hebrew: אם עמד ניקף - בסדר המשנה ל"ג בהדיא ניקף, אלא ללישנא דמפרש התם דקאי אניקף, דייק הכא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:7:1.english: If [the owner of] the surrounded [field] arose - In the text of the Mishnah, we do not explicitly read "the surrounded [owner]"; rather, according to the version that explains there that it refers to the surrounded [owner], [the Gemara] infers [this] here:

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:7:2.hebrew: טעמא דניקף הא מקיף פטור - ואפילו רבנן לא פליגי אלא משום דא"ל: "את גרמת לי הקיפא יתירא". וא"ת: ואי זה נהנה וזה לא חסר פטור, אפילו עמד ניקף נמי? וי"ל: שאני עמד ניקף, דגלי אדעתיה דניחא ליה בהוצאה; ולא דמי לדר בחצר חבירו, דלא גלי אדעתיה אלא בחנם:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 20b:7:2.english: The reason is that [the owner of] the surrounded [field enclosed it], whereas [if the owner of] the surrounding [field enclosed it], he is exempt - And even the Rabbis only disagree because they say to him, "You caused me extra fencing." And if you ask: If [in a case of] "this one benefits and this one does not lose," he is exempt, [then] even if [the owner of] the surrounded [field] arose [and enclosed it], [he should] also [be exempt]? And one can answer: [The case where the owner of] the surrounded [field] arose [and enclosed it] is different, for he revealed his intention that he is amenable to the expense; and it is not comparable to one who dwells in his fellow's courtyard, for he only revealed his intention [to dwell there] for free.
